title: Brian Schottenheimer: We won't have to reach in draft to fill needs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer: We won't have to reach in draft to fill needs
sources.description: The Cowboys added another free agent this week when they signed cornerback Darrion Kendrick and head coach Brian Schottenheimer weighed in on the team's overall moves over the last few weeks while at the University of Texas Pro Day workout on Tuesday.
